proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.spell_source_filter
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive rider needs to grant advantage only on saving throws caused by spells, not on all saving throws.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this ring, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells.

proposed_widenings.name: passive_operation.trigger.spell_save_outcome
proposed_widenings.justification: The ring has an automatic post-save effect that cancels a qualifying spell on a successful save without spending a reaction. Existing passive operations only support elapsed-time cadence, so there is no honest way to encode this deterministic trigger in the passive half of the item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you.

notes: Do not author a placeholder content file. The optional reflection rider itself fits existing triggered-reaction surface pieces, but the item's passive half is incomplete without spell-only save filtering and automatic post-save spell negation.
